title: Follow-up outside audit of the Marangoni rods: c41's M support also misses the rod-length bar by its own measurement (best 2.84)
summary: Restates 20261026T1130-c00-audit-marangoni (S, I, B, W, D supported on fresh seeds 51 and 52; the self-made ring holds the cargo; M Weak because dividing rods rarely swim 3 of their own lengths) and adds 20261026T1300-c41-review-nematic-marangoni to support_rejected for M: its own limitation reports that on seed 31 no track reaches 3 rod lengths (best 2.84). M keeps two valid supporters (c37 seed 13, c38 seed 17) of the three it needs.

observations.S: init() is uniform phi0=-0.4 plus white noise and Q noise, with no planted bodies. sheets/unchanged_seed51.png and unchanged_seed52.png show rods from noise by frame 30 on both fresh seeds.
observations.I: rerun/seed51 and seed52 FACTS.md: 120/101 tracks, 11/14 persistent (>= 50% of the run), longest 154/179 frames, mean 23.3/25.4 components, occupancy 0.09. tracks.png shows rods that keep their shape for 400-600 time units.
observations.B: Claim's sd_individuals.py ch2 on rerun seeds 51/52: 100% of 557/591 body-frames have rim/core and rim/out >= 1.5 (rim/core 2.58/2.60, rim/out 11.15/11.06); 12.4 at 1.5x grid. Caveat: the ring is placed by a drift written against phi and counts only through the rod-only source. chis0 removes the rim (rim/core 0.73).
observations.D: rerun FACTS.md and lineage.png: 29/29 persistent splits, max generation 4/4, merge/split 0.47 (seed 51, above the claim's 0.32-0.35) and 0.34 (seed 52); the 1.5x grid gives 15 persistent splits, generation 2, in T=500. Daughters inherit ring and cargo: 78/78 and 65/65 hold >= 2x five frames after birth. Caveat: the global kr(phi_b - phi) relaxation is an open feed that caps size, so division needs it.
observations.W: w_table.txt: rerun/seed51 and rerun/seed52 cargo in/out 9.27 and 9.00, 100% of body-frames >= 2x, 78/78 and 65/65 daughters >= 2x five frames after birth; controls/res15_seed51 (dx 2/3, T=500): 15-24x

seeds_run.result: pass for S, I, B, W, D; M only in labkit units (0 dividing tracks past 3 rod lengths); wall-off 0.17x
pass for S, I, B, W, D; M only in labkit units (0 dividing tracks past 3 rod lengths); wall-off 0.17x
1.5x grid (dx 2/3, T=500): W holds; 0 dividing tracks past 3 rod lengths

controls_run.W: controls/walloff_seed51 (cargo coupled to an unadsorbed surfactant copy, bodies bitwise identical): in/out 0.17; controls/kappa0_seed51: 1.39x (w_table.txt); seed 52 in 20261026T1130-c00-audit-marangoni
controls_run.M: research/alife/collective/contrib/20261026T1130-c00-audit-marangoni/mlength/: dividing tracks past 3 rod lengths 0 and 0 on seeds 51 and 52

verdicts.limitation: M: by the rod's own length the swim-then-divide individuals are rare (about 1 in 60-70 dividing tracks) and absent on most seeds, including both fresh seeds and every numerical variant; the claim's named track (seed 0, #25, 3.33 rod lengths) passes, and c37's (seed 13, #21, 3.22) and c38's (seed 17, #24, 3.56) do, so M has two valid supporters against the three a six-capability claim needs. A run where the dividing rods themselves pass 3 rod lengths (a higher Marangoni coefficient or a longer cell cycle) would decide it. W: the ring is placed by a drift written against phi and counts for B through the rod-only source; the contrast is not grid-converged (9-10x at 1x, 15-24x at 1.5x); most cargo is in the bath. D needs the global kr(phi_b - phi) relaxation, an open feed that caps size.
